original_prompt.prompt: Create a compelling product description for a new eco-friendly water bottle. Highlight its sustainable features and unique selling points.

clarity.description: Evaluation of prompt clarity and specificity
suggestions: Add more specific details about the features

structure.description: Assessment of reasoning flow and organization
suggestions: Provide a clearer structure for the description
Include examples of similar product descriptions
Consider using bullet points for clarity
Specify the desired length of the description

enhanced_prompt.prompt: Create a compelling product description for a new eco-friendly water bottle aimed at environmentally conscious consumers. Highlight its sustainable features, such as biodegradable materials and reusable design, and unique selling points, like an innovative filtration system and stylish design. The tone should be engaging and persuasive. Respond in 100-150 words, utilizing bullet points for the features and benefits.
